name: artboard_options_a4_preset_sets_the_size
note: apply_artboard_preset: A4 is 595.28 x 841.89, the size its dropdown label states.

name: artboard_options_landscape_swaps_the_sides
note: The dialog starts portrait at 612 x 792; toggle_artboard_orientation swaps width and height. Opened through the action door, whose scope carries no active_document.artboards (the Artboard tool's and the panel's doors do), so the init reads nothing and the dialog starts at its declared 612 x 792; the case pins the orientation law, not the init.

name: artboard_options_the_shown_orientation_changes_nothing
note: The behavior's condition: pressing the orientation already shown (portrait) does not run the swap. Opened through the action door, whose scope carries no active_document.artboards (the Artboard tool's and the panel's doors do), so the init reads nothing and the dialog starts at its declared 612 x 792; the case pins the orientation law, not the init.
